about.grid: : interlocking core, edge and corner tiles (strips for a single row or column).
about.how: Enter your wall size, pick a tile size, a tile setup and a mounting method. The planner fills the wall with full tiles, adds smaller tiles along the right and top edges, and lists every part.
about.single: : bordered tiles joined by dual clips.
about.snapColours: Snap colours: yellow single, orange dual, red quad.
about.source: The layout and counting rules are a port of the official Multiboard Planner (multiboard.itch.io/planner). Each part opens from your Tool: Multiboard models collection once Thingport has it, or on Thangs until then.
build.cancelled: Stopped before the rest were drawn.
build.missing: {part} isn’t here to add to the file.
build.nothing: There’s nothing in this wall to save.
fetch.message: Thingport hasn't got {count} of this wall's parts yet. They can be fetched now, and the wall then saved as one model.
fetch.refused: Without its parts the wall can't be saved as a model. Its list and its files can still be downloaded.
fetch.title: Fetch the parts?
models.none: Thingport hasn’t added the joint parts yet: they open on Thangs for now.
models.some: {missing} of {total} joint parts aren’t in Thingport yet: those open on Thangs.
mount.help: How the board attaches to the wall. Offset snaps and free-standing mounts are counted per tile corner; shared corners use dual or quad parts.
mount.title: Mounting
notes.files: Each file is named with how many of it you need.
notes.howSupports: No supports needed; print the parts as they lie.
notes.howTolerance: Designed to a 0.25 mm tolerance. Print one tile and check it fits before printing a wall.
notes.orderMounts: Then the mounting parts, which you only need once the boards are up.
notes.orderTiles: The boards first, so you can lay the wall out and check it fits.
part.thangsAria: Open the model for {name} on Thangs
parts.copyHint: Copy the list as tab-separated text
parts.listHint: Download the list with the layout as an HTML page
parts.title: Parts
save.hint: Save this wall to your library as one model, with every part as its own file
save.name: What to call it
save.note: {parts} different parts, {files} to print in all. Each becomes its own file, named with how many you need.
save.title: Save this wall to Thingport
setup.help: Single tiles: every tile has its own border, joined with dual clips. Grid tiles: core, edge and corner tiles that interlock into one bordered board.
setup.title: Tile setup
tile.help: Largest tile you print, in 25 mm grid cells. Smaller tiles fill the leftover strip at the right and top edges.
tile.title: Tile size
toast.copyFailed: Copy failed: the browser blocked the clipboard
toast.nothingToSave: None of this wall's parts are in Thingport yet, so there's nothing to save.
unused.title: Unused space
